name: pancake_get_raw_conversation
description: Fetch a conversation's raw metadata and messages directly from the Pancake Public API (with automatic collection-scan fallback when Pancake's single-conversation v2 endpoint returns HTML). Read-only.

target.description: Pancake URL or Pancake conversation ID (e.g. 1131614906706493_27102859622703796)

type.description: Conversation type hint for collection fallback (default: INBOX)

includeRawMessages.description: Include raw unfiltered Pancake message objects (default: false)
